newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Cellular telephone system operational in Senegal.
newsitem.headline: Cellular telephone system operational in Senegal.

text.p: Senegal's state telecommunications company SONATEL (La Societe Nationale des Telecommunications du Senegal) has started the West African nation's first cellular telephone service, a senior company official said on Monday.
The network, which uses a GSM system and currently has 600 customers, had become operational and a formal launch was planned for the coming weeks, the official added.
SONATEL is earmarked for privatisation around the end of the year and the cellular network would be part of the sell-off, the official told Reuters.
About 20 European, American and Asian companies have expressed interest in the privatisation.
SONATEL's 1995 turnover was 53.6 billion CFA francs against almost 57.5 billion in 1994. The 1995 net profit was six billion CFA against 12 billion in 1994.
